description: This file defines various exception classes used in the Behave testing framework, including custom error classes for constraints, configuration, steps, file handling, and plugin import errors.

classes.name: ConstraintError
classes.description: Used if a constraint/precondition is not fulfilled at runtime.

classes.name: ResourceExistsError
classes.description: Used if you try to register a resource and another exists already with the same name.

classes.name: ConfigError
classes.description: Used if the configuration is (partially) invalid.

classes.name: ConfigParamTypeError
classes.description: Used if a config-param has the wrong type.

classes.name: StepNotImplementedError
classes.description: Should be raised if a step is not implemented yet.

classes.name: StepFunctionTypeError
classes.description: Wrong step function type is used.

classes.name: PendingStepError
classes.description: Alternative to StepNotImplementedError for a pending step.

classes.name: CleanupError
classes.description: Used if exception is raised during cleanup/cleanup-function.

classes.name: InvalidFileLocationError
classes.description: Used if a behave.model_core.FileLocation is invalid, occurs if the file location is no exactly correct and strict checking is enabled.

classes.name: InvalidFilenameError
classes.description: Used if a filename does not have the expected file extension, etc.

classes.name: ClassNotFoundError
classes.description: Used if module to import exists, but class with this name does not exist.

classes.name: ObjectNotFoundError
classes.description: Used if module to import exists, but object with this name does not exist.

classes.name: InvalidClassError
classes.description: Used if the specified class has the wrong type: not a class or not a subclass of a required class.

classes.name: NotSupportedWarning
classes.description: Used if a certain functionality is not supported.
